summary.en: US futures trade mixed as investors digest geopolitical tensions, elevated oil prices below $100, and AI hyperscaler earnings pressure. Intel's strong bounce contrasts with broader tech weakness following Mag7 rout on Thursday.
summary.zh: 美股期指分化，投资者消化地缘紧张、油价虽回落但仍居高位 ($98 附近)，以及大厂 AI 营收预期压力。英伟达等巨头周四大跌后科技股承压，Intel 强劲反弹形成鲜明对比。

title.en: Oil Prices Drop Below $100 as Geopolitical Risk Eases Slightly
title.zh: 油价跌破$100，地缘政治风险小幅缓和

impact.en: WTI/Brent stabilization provides breathing room for growth stocks; inflation fears persist but easing reduces stagflation risk premium. MacroRisk: Moderate transmission via energy-sensitive sectors.
impact.zh: 油价稳定为成长股提供空间；通胀担忧仍存但缓解，降低滞胀风险溢价。宏观传导：能源敏感型板块受益。

macroRisk.en: Oil below $100 reduces stagflation concerns, but supply chain disruptions and geopolitical premiums maintain volatility.
macroRisk.zh: $98 油价缓解滞胀担忧，但供应链中断和地缘溢价维持波动。

title.en: Intel Leads Chip Stocks with 25% Revenue Jump, Nasdaq Futures Recover
title.zh: Intel 收入跃升 25%，引领芯片股反弹，纳斯达克期货回升

impact.en: Semiconductor rally suggests bottoming process near July 17 support at $48. Intel earnings surprise offsets AI spending concerns, but hyperscaler capex debate persists.
impact.zh: 半导体 Rally 显示接近$48 的技术支撑有效。Intel 业绩超预期抵消开支担忧，但超大规模云厂商资本支出辩论持续。

macroRisk.en: AI sector divergence: Capex sustainability question vs. demand realization creates mixed sentiment.
macroRisk.zh: AI 板块分化：资本支出可持续性疑问与需求实现形成混合情绪。

title.en: Trump Tariff Strikes Again as Trade Tensions Escalate
title.zh: 特朗普关税政策再出重拳，贸易紧张局势升级

impact.en: New tariff threats create uncertainty for multinational corporations; consumer discretionary and industrials face margin pressure from import costs.
impact.zh: 新关税威胁令跨国企业不确定；消费可选和工业面临进口成本挤压利润。

macroRisk.en: Trade policy volatility transmits to earnings multiples, particularly for tech with global supply chains.
macroRisk.zh: 贸易政策波动传导至盈利倍数，尤其对全球供应链的科技股。

title.en: Wall Street Shakes Off Iran Jitters After Thursday Mag7 Rout
title.zh: 美股市在周四巨头暴跌后摆脱伊朗紧张局势影响

impact.en: Futures edge higher despite geopolitical headlines; risk appetite recovering but remains sensitive to Middle East escalation and energy shocks.
impact.zh: 尽管地缘头条，期指微幅回升；风险偏好恢复但敏感于中东升级和能源冲击。

macroRisk.en: Geopolitical premium in oil prices remains elevated; any Middle East escalation would spike WTI toward $105.
macroRisk.zh: 油价地缘溢价仍高；中东任何升级会将 WTI 推高至$105。

title.en: Treasury Yields Stabilize as Inflation Expectations Cool
title.zh: 美债收益率稳定，通胀预期降温

impact.en: 10Y Treasury yield holds steady near 4.2%; rate-sensitive sectors stabilize after volatile week, providing clarity for equity positioning.
impact.zh: 10Y 国债维持在$4.2 左右；利率敏感板块波动后企稳，为股票配置提供清晰度。

macroRisk.en: Bond market clarity supports growth stocks, but fiscal deficits and yield curve control regime create underlying uncertainty.
macroRisk.zh: 债券市场清晰度支持成长股，但财政赤字和收益率曲线控制机制造成内在不确定。

title.en: Dollar Index Consolidates as Rate Differential Plays Mellow
title.zh: 美元指数盘整，利率差博弈缓和

impact.en: DXY holds neutral near 106.5; Fed rate cut expectations vs. yield dynamics balance out, benefitting multinationals with global exposure.
impact.zh: DXY在中性区$106.5；降息预期与收益率动力平衡，利于全球化企业。

macroRisk.en: Dollar stability supports EM assets and commodity exporters, reducing FX headwinds for global tech.
macroRisk.zh: 美元稳定支持新兴市场资产和大宗商品出口商，减少全球科技的外汇逆风。

title.en: Market Absorbs AI Anxiety Amidst Broader Tech Correction
title.zh: 市场吸收 AI 焦虑 amid 更广的科技调整

impact.en: AI sector correction continues as investors question capex sustainability; divergence between hyperscalers and hardware suppliers intensifies.
impact.zh: AI 板块继续回调，投资者质疑资本支出可持续性；云厂商与硬件供应商分化加剧。

macroRisk.en: Sector rotation away from mega-cap tech toward value/small caps signals style shift amid growth concerns.
macroRisk.zh: 从大盘科技向价值/小盘轮动显示成长担忧中的风格切换。

ai.en: AI sector under pressure following Mag7 rout, but hyperscaler earnings remain strong; divergence between software and hardware persists.
ai.zh: AI 板块在巨头暴跌后承压，但超大规模云厂商业绩强劲；软件与硬件分化持续。

semiconductor.en: Intel bounce validates bottoming process; memory demand recovering while logic chip competition intensifies. AMD/AVVO show mixed signals.
semiconductor.zh: Intel 反弹确认筑底过程；内存需求恢复，逻辑芯片竞争加剧。AMD/QCOM信号混合。

bigTech.en: Big Tech weak on capex sustainability concerns; Alphabet/Tesla earnings questioned by market despite strong revenue. Cloud growth slowing.
bigTech.zh: 大盘科技因资本支出可持续性担忧而疲软；Alphabet/特斯拉营收强劲但业绩遭质疑，云增长放缓。

energy.en: Oil below $100 provides relief but supply constraints persist; renewable transition plays mixed as policy uncertainty dominates.
energy.zh: $98 油价提供缓解但仍受供应限制；能源转型项目分化，政策不确定占主导。

ev.en: EV sector faces headwinds from higher energy costs and tariff threats. Traditional OEMs gain margin on EV slowdown while Chinese competition intensifies.
ev.zh: 电动车受更高成本和新关税威胁拖累。传统车企在电动车放缓时获得利润率，但中国竞争加剧。

market.en: Broad market mixed after Mag7 rout, with S&P stabilizing near key support. Semiconductor rally offsets broader weakness as Intel/AMD lead.
market.zh: 大盘巨头暴跌后混合，标普稳定在关键支撑附近。半导体反弹抵消疲软，Intel/AMD 领涨。

preciousMetals.en: Gold consolidates near $2800, DXY stability limiting upside; geopolitical premium remains but rate dynamics cap gains.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金在$2800附近盘整，美元稳定限制上行；地缘溢价仍在但利率动态封顶。

oil.en: WTI drops below $98, providing respite for growth stocks but supply disruptions and geopolitical tensions prevent sustained decline.
oil.zh: $98油价为成长股喘息，但供应中断和地缘紧张防止持续下跌。

futures.en: Nasdaq futures edging higher on Intel-led semiconductor rally; S&P500 mixed after Thursday sell-off. Dow holds near support.
futures.zh: 纳斯达克期货在英伟达领涨半导体反弹中微升；标普 500 周四暴跌后混合，道指接近支撑。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y yield stabilizes near 4.2%, providing clarity after volatile week in bonds.
treasury10Y.zh: 10Y 收益率在$4.2%附近稳定，债券市场波动周后提供清晰度。

dxy.en: DXY holds around 106.5, rate cut expectations balance with yield dynamics.
dxy.zh: 美元指数维持在$106.5 左右，降息预期与收益率动态平衡。

oil.en: WTI trades near $98, Brent below $92; geopolitical premium limits downside but supply concerns cap upside.
oil.zh: $98 附近交易，Brent 低于$92；地缘溢价限制下行但供应担忧封顶上行。

keyRisk.en: Geopolitical escalation in Middle East could spike WTI toward $105, triggering inflation resurgence and equity volatility.
keyRisk.zh: 中东升级可能将原油推高至$105，引发通胀卷土重来和股市波动。

note.en: Mixed sentiment reflects sector divergence: semiconductor bounce vs. big tech weakness, oil stabilization but geopolitical premiums persist.
note.zh: 混合情绪反映板块分化：半导体反弹与大盘科技疲软，油价稳定但地缘溢价持续。
